name: Pertuzumab
route_note: IV infusion every 3 weeks with trastuzumab; fixed-dose SC combination (Phesgo)

discovery.note: Humanised form of the murine antibody 2C4 binding the HER2 dimerisation domain.

tagline: HER2 dimerisation blocker used with trastuzumab for dual HER2 blockade
summary: Pertuzumab is a humanised monoclonal antibody that binds a different epitope of HER2 from trastuzumab and blocks receptor dimerisation. Given with trastuzumab and chemotherapy, it improves outcomes in HER2-positive metastatic and early breast cancer.
mechanism: Pertuzumab binds extracellular subdomain II of HER2, the dimerisation arm, preventing HER2 from forming ligand-dependent heterodimers, especially with HER3, the most potent signalling pair.
This blocks PI3K–AKT and MAPK signalling and complements trastuzumab, which binds subdomain IV; together they provide more complete HER2 pathway inhibition. Pertuzumab also mediates ADCC.
uses: HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (first-line, with trastuzumab and docetaxel)
Neoadjuvant treatment of HER2-positive early breast cancer
Adjuvant treatment of high-risk HER2-positive early breast cancer

history.title: Structural basis
history.detail: Crystal structures show pertuzumab binds the HER2 dimerisation domain, distinct from the trastuzumab epitope.

history.title: CLEOPATRA and approval
history.detail: Adding pertuzumab to trastuzumab–docetaxel prolongs survival; FDA approves Perjeta in June.

history.title: Neoadjuvant approval
history.detail: Accelerated approval for neoadjuvant treatment — the first FDA approval based on pathological complete response in breast cancer.

history.title: Survival benefit
history.detail: Final CLEOPATRA analysis reports a median overall survival gain of about 16 months.

history.title: Adjuvant approval
history.detail: Approved for adjuvant use after the APHINITY trial.

history.title: Phesgo
history.detail: FDA approves Phesgo, a subcutaneous fixed-dose combination of pertuzumab, trastuzumab and hyaluronidase.

pk.metabolism: Proteolytic catabolism to peptides and amino acids (no CYP metabolism)
pk.excretion: Not renally excreted as intact antibody; cleared by catabolism and target-mediated uptake

safety.boxed_warning: Left ventricular dysfunction and embryo-fetal toxicity.

facts: Pertuzumab is always given together with trastuzumab rather than alone.
Its neoadjuvant approval in 2013 was the first FDA approval for breast cancer based on pathological complete response.
